note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English, with alate and soldier described but no worker. Distribution records, synonymic citations and figure numbers are not included.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate head capsule subcircular, width including the compound eyes 1.30–1.40 mm, compound eyes large, round and protruding, ocelli separated from the compound eye by about 1/3 of the minor ocellar diameter, antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 2 times as long as segment 2; soldier head capsule pyriform, antennae 14-segmented, mandibles vestigial with long spine-like processes.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule rusty brown to dark fuscous brown, anterior part of the rostrum paler; antennae pale yellowish brown; pronotum paler than the head capsule, anterior lobe darker; abdominal tergites brown, sternites brownish yellow; legs pale yellow. Head without hairs or setae; apex of the rostrum with 4 hairs; anterior margin of the pronotum with microsetae; anterior abdominal tergites without hairs, the last few segments with a few setae, sternites with long setae. Head capsule pyriform, constricted behind the antennae; length with rostrum 1.37–1.94 mm, length without rostrum 0.80–1.17 mm, width 0.59–1.17 mm; in lateral view distinctly concave behind the rostrum, without an elevation. Rostrum long and cylindrical, 0.64–0.77 mm long, longer than half the length of the head without rostrum. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 about 2 times as long as segment 2, segment 4 slightly shorter than or subequal to segment 3. Mandibles vestigial, each with a prominent long spine-like process; right mandible with a minute, inconspicuous tooth below the apical process. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior and posterior margins with shallow notches, 0.15–0.28 mm long, 0.33–0.56 mm wide.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule brown, antennae yellow with a reddish tinge, postclypeus and labrum yellow; pronotum pale brown, with a yellow T-shaped mark medially and an ocellus-like spot on each shoulder. Head sparsely pilose; postclypeus with 1 hair on each side of the median line; pronotal pilosity denser than that of the head. Head oval, head capsule subcircular, length of head to the base of the mandibles 0.97–1.01 mm, width including the compound eyes 1.30–1.40 mm. Fontanelle plate prominent, larger than the ocelli, with 4 small dot-like spots in front of it. Compound eyes large, round and protruding, very close to the lateral margin of the head, maximum diameter 0.46–0.49 mm, minimum diameter 0.39–0.44 mm, distance from the lower margin of the eye to the margin of the head 0.05 mm. Ocelli large and oval, separated from the compound eye by 1/3 of their minor diameter, major diameter 0.18–0.19 mm, minor diameter 0.10–0.13 mm, ocellus–eye distance 0.03 mm. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 2 times as long as segment 2. Postclypeus moderately raised, less than half as long as wide, 0.20 mm long, 0.49–0.54 mm wide. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal, longer than half its width, 0.67–0.72 mm long, 1.04–1.14 mm wide, anterior margin straight without a notch, posterior margin slightly concave medially.
